name: LX Semicon Co., Ltd.
summary: LX Semicon Co., Ltd. operates as a semiconductor company in South Korea, China, Vietnam, Taiwan, Japan, and internationally. The company offers organic light emitting diode (OLED) and liquid crystal display (LCD) solutions; RealTouch, an in-cell touch technology with touch function in display panels; OLED and LCD timing controller; video processor; power management IC; level shifter; general and motor micro controller unit; motor and gate driver IC; metalized ceramic substrate, a heat dissipation substrate; and heat dissipation material.
